text_block_list.text:
The mysterious ball Fuji Kiseki invited us 
to. The day has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, there you are. Making this King 
wait—quite the bold move.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now everyone's here! I can't wait any 
longer! Let's go, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The venue is the multipurpose hall in this 
art museum. Are you prepared and resolved?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! We're settling that dance battle from 
the other day right here and now!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just what I wanted!

The two exchange glances and smile. Their 
burning enthusiasm is palpable even to 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Onward to the ball...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Dazzling spotlights, a sea of invited 
guests... Ah, this truly is a grand ball!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
B-But... doesn't this seem kinda different 
from what we expected, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Cheerleader Girl
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone get their pom-poms~? Let's go 
over the routine together!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person in Happi Coat
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho! Soiyassassa! Alright, my joints 
are feeling mighty fine today!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Cheerleading and happi coats?! Isn't this 
far too chaotic for a ball?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, my sweet ponies. I'm so glad 
you could make it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai! Um, what kind of unique ball 
is this...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today is a gathering of the local dance 
club, full of people who love dancing from 
the bottom of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone loves to dance... that sounds 
awesome! El absolutely adores having fun, 
deee-su!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
E-El-san?! You can't be serious, doing 
that with complete strangers...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it wonderful? Fellow dance 
lovers hitting it off instantly.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Cha-cha-cha♪ Cha-cha-cha♪ Looking great! 
You're super good at this, desu yo~!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, inviting you two was definitely the 
right choice.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Since this is an event to enjoy dancing 
across all ages and genres, I wanted to 
invite people who could bring the energy 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gathering together to just dance! 
It's simple, but please make yourself at 
home and have fun!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Gathering together... Ah, so that's what 
you meant by that...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In that case, leave it to this first-class 
lady! With my flawless dancing, I shall 
liven up this gathering!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. I know how hard you practiced 
for today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, may I have this 
dance?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...! It would be my honor!

King Halo and Fuji Kiseki delivered an 
enchanting dance, captivating the entire 
floor and commanding everyone's attention.

text_block_list.name: Cheerleader Girl
text_block_list.text:
So pretty...! Look how her tail swishes 
when she twirls!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Person in Happi Coat
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, magnificent elegance...! I can 
almost see the illusion of a royal castle 
ballroom before my very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone was totally enchanted by 
you. Thank you for giving them such a 
wonderful performance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! After all, I am the flower of 
high society, the shining star of the 
dance floor!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...You looked just like an angel 
descending from the heavens.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hauhh?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I am first-class, after all! It can't be 
helped if I looked that way to you, 
right?! O-ho-ho-ho!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Now then, everyone! Please, gaze 
upon the King's dance to your hearts' 
content!

Surrounded by many passionate dancers, 
King Halo spent a dazzling and delightful 
time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank you very much. That was 
quite enjoyable!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was all mine. Thank you for 
such a lovely time, my sweet pony.

text_block_list.name: Formally Dressed Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, young lady in the emerald 
dress, might we have a moment of your 
time?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Formally Dressed Elderly Person A
text_block_list.text:
You see, we belong to a ballroom dance 
circle... If it wouldn't be too much 
trouble, would you grant us a dance?

text_block_list.name: Formally Dressed Elderly Person B
text_block_list.text:
I would also love to have a dance with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Formally Dressed Elderly Person C
text_block_list.text: Huf, me as well... please!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: S-So many of you...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Well, everyone simply desires a dance 
with King! A truly first-class lady 
accepts all challengers!

Having danced with every single person, 
King Halo was utterly exhausted, though 
her face beamed with unmistakable pride.
